style: painted broadcast-poster illustration, bold ink outlines, saturated colours with a warm rim light, cinematic 16:9 wide shot, the fighter centred and fully in frame in the middle of the picture with empty space above and below, dramatic stage lighting, confetti and haze, no text, no lettering, no watermark

ball-person.look: a soccer-armoured fighter in cleats, face split between blonde hair and a glowing circuit
ball-person.scene: alone on a floodlit pitch at night, one foot on a ball, the whole stadium standing and chanting, a goal net glowing behind
ball-person.l1: The stadium empties. The chant does not.
ball-person.l2: Ball Person scores once more, in an empty net.

blog-man.look: a man in glasses, red cape and yellow shirt
blog-man.scene: at a glowing newsroom desk, typing, a giant printed front page unrolling behind him, cape over the chair
blog-man.l1: He files the story before the cameras are off.
blog-man.l2: Blog Man writes the headline. It is about him.

break.look: a fighter in pink power armour with spiked gauntlets and a furnace-glow visor
break.scene: standing unmoved in the middle of a cracked arena floor, rubble all around, fists planted, visor burning
break.l1: Everyone else is on the floor.
break.l2: Break never fell. Rule one still holds.

cel.look: a winged archer in white and gold with a galaxy across the feathers
cel.scene: mid-air above a night skyline, bow lowered, wings spread, an arrow-trail of stars behind
cel.l1: Three extra jumps. All of them used.
cel.l2: Cel lands last, and drawn best.

chooser.look: a round puff of blue and yellow fur standing on paintbrush legs
chooser.scene: on a gallery stage in front of six glowing doorways, one open, paint splashed on the floor
chooser.l2: Chooser picks the seventh. Nobody saw it.

crosser.look: a fighter with a white braid and a blue and white jacket, still stance
crosser.scene: standing at a rain-wet crossroads under a single streetlight, arms folded, neon signs in the wet road
crosser.l2: Crosser remembers every one who crossed him.

crystalline-intelligences.look: a being of gold wire and light with fire gathered in both hands
crystalline-intelligences.scene: hovering in a dark studio full of floating glowing equations, fire in cupped hands, gold threads reaching out
crystalline-intelligences.l2: Probability of another fight: zero point zero.

dj-wont-read.look: a fighter with headphones, a lit visor and glowing vials across a black vest
dj-wont-read.scene: behind a glowing deck on the stage, hands up, vials lit, crowd lights pulsing, a dark silent booth beside
dj-wont-read.l1: One last record. No one asked.
dj-wont-read.l2: DJ Won't Read drops it. Won't read the reviews.

evil-blue-bird.look: a blue bird with a toothy grin and mismatched eyes
evil-blue-bird.scene: perched on the top of a broadcast tower at sunrise, feathers ruffled, grinning, a chain of cartoon cheering birds below
evil-blue-bird.l1: The tower is quiet at dawn.
evil-blue-bird.l2: Evil Blue Bird tweets. The network listens.

exit-punk.look: a kid with a skateboard, hood up, tired and unimpressed
exit-punk.scene: walking away from a dark studio down an empty street at dawn, skateboard under one arm, a glowing EXIT sign behind, door swinging shut
exit-punk.l1: The set goes dark behind him.
exit-punk.l2: Exit Punk finds the door. It was never locked.

future-man.look: a fighter with red hair, glowing blue eyes and circuitry running into the skin
future-man.scene: on a rooftop at midnight reading a glowing screen of tomorrow's headlines, city below, calm smile
future-man.l2: Future Man was right again. Spoilers withheld.

got-ur-back.look: a huge soft blue-furred fighter with an orange bow tie and a gentle smile
got-ur-back.scene: standing guard in an empty arena, huge and warm, a little crowd of small silhouettes sleeping safe behind him
got-ur-back.l1: The lights dim. Everyone is behind him.
got-ur-back.l2: Got Ur Back keeps his word. Nobody got past.

kaelen.look: a fighter in a neon green jacket with a blue visor and a gauntlet lit at the wrist
kaelen.scene: a streak of green neon light across a city bridge at night, the fighter stopped mid-stride and turning, afterimages behind
kaelen.l1: A flash on the bridge. Then nothing.
kaelen.l2: Kaelen was gone before the cameras turned.

lapis-man.look: an old man with a wooden staff topped with a glowing blue stone
lapis-man.scene: on a quiet mountain path at dusk, leaning on the staff, the blue stone lighting the path, an old temple gate behind
lapis-man.l1: The staff finds the path home.
lapis-man.l2: Lapis Man walks it slowly. Respect, earned.

not-an-old-man-yet.look: a gray-haired man in a burgundy velvet jacket, owning the room
not-an-old-man-yet.scene: in a velvet armchair in the middle of a grand stage, brandy in hand, stage lights on him, an empty auditorium of red seats
not-an-old-man-yet.l1: He owns the middle of the room.
not-an-old-man-yet.l2: Not an Old Man Yet. Still not yet.

orchestrator.look: a host in a tuxedo with a conductor's baton
orchestrator.scene: on an empty orchestra podium, baton raised, a vast dark studio of empty chairs, a single spotlight
orchestrator.l1: The pit is full. The seats are not.
orchestrator.l2: The Orchestrator raises the baton. The show goes on.

pyro-singer.look: a singer with a microphone in one hand and a ball of fire in the other
pyro-singer.scene: centre stage at a concert, microphone raised, flames curling from the other hand, a sea of lit phones
pyro-singer.l2: Pyro Singer opens and closes the night.

shark-dude.look: a fighter with a shark-fin mohawk, sunglasses, and a denim jacket over a jaws graphic
shark-dude.scene: on a rooftop at sunset with a shark-fin mohawk, arms crossed, a championship belt thrown over a chair, waves of a city skyline behind
shark-dude.l1: The belt stays on the chair.
shark-dude.l2: Shark Dude bites. The belt isn't a belt.

shutup-bot.look: a round robot with a screen for a face showing a flat unimpressed mouth
shutup-bot.scene: alone on a dark stage, round robot centred, flat screen face showing a straight line, spotlights, the crowd silent
shutup-bot.l1: The crowd waits for a word.
shutup-bot.l2: Shutup Bot says nothing. It is a very loud nothing.

slice.look: a fighter in a black coat with a black bob haircut and a scalpel held low
slice.scene: standing in a rainy alley under a red neon sign, coat blowing, scalpel low, a perfect clean line cut through a brick wall behind
slice.l1: A thin line across the wall.
slice.l2: Slice sheathes the blade. Clean, as promised.

slow-rider.look: a cowboy-hatted rider with a hawk overhead
slow-rider.scene: riding slowly into a desert sunset, hat low, a hawk circling above, long shadows, a dust-trail road
slow-rider.l1: Dust settles on an empty road.
slow-rider.l2: Slow Rider takes the long way. No rush.

small-weather.look: a fighter in glasses with a glowing rig and a small private storm wrapped around his hands
small-weather.scene: standing on a rooftop with a tiny thundercloud above, a clear sky opening behind, rain on one side, rainbow on the other
small-weather.l2: Small Weather's forecast: clear skies, for a minute.

spider-bot.look: a mechanical spider with a pilot in the glass cockpit
spider-bot.scene: climbing a huge steel girder under floodlights, eight legs spread, the pilot waving through the glass, sparks
spider-bot.l1: Eight legs. All of them planted.
spider-bot.l2: Spider Bot spins the finale. The net holds.

ss-boulder.look: a fighter holding a giant boulder
ss-boulder.scene: on a mountaintop at golden hour, setting the boulder down gently like a trophy, mountains beyond, clouds
ss-boulder.l2: SS Boulder wins. The boulder always wins.

stratabots.look: a low-poly rock-bodied fighter in stacked plates with a small hard face
stratabots.scene: a canyon at sunrise, standing in a landslide of rock plates reassembling, cracked opponent rubble around
stratabots.l1: The plates settle. The rubble does not.

susan.look: a fighter in dark armour with shadow pooling around her boots and long tendrils
susan.scene: standing in a dark cathedral, a pool of shadow spreading from her boots, tendrils of dark reaching, one shaft of moonlight
susan.l2: Susan prefers the dark. Stay in it.

the-mechanic.look: a tired man with a stained shirt and a wrench over one shoulder
the-mechanic.scene: on a stage after the show, workbench lights, a toolbox open, bolting the last stage panel back down, empty seats
the-mechanic.l1: The cameras are off. The stage is broken.
the-mechanic.l2: The Mechanic tightens the last bolt. Show's over.

try-belt.look: a fighter in a leather jacket with a face split by red light and blue light
try-belt.scene: in a boxing ring under police-light red and blue, belt in hand, ring ropes, a photographer's flash
try-belt.l2: Try Belt tried. Twice. It counted.

tt.look: a green turtle in round glasses standing like he would rather be reading
tt.scene: in a cosy library nook with a pile of books, turtle in round glasses, one hand on a stack, a trophy used as a bookend
tt.l2: TT finishes the match, then the chapter.

uh-me.look: a small gray alien with large black eyes and a very calm stance
uh-me.scene: floating gently above a quiet night field, a tiny gray alien under a huge moon, a ship humming behind, stars
uh-me.l2: Uh Me. Done. Home by midnight.

wallit.look: a leather wallet fighter with cash sticking out of the top and a bat in one glove
wallit.scene: standing on a huge pile of cash in a vault, bat on one shoulder, bills falling like confetti
wallit.l2: Wallit clears the card, and the bill.

yo-bot.look: a laptop with robot arms and four mechanical legs
yo-bot.scene: on a dark desk-like stage, screen glowing a progress bar at 100 percent, arms raised, four legs braced, cables everywhere
yo-bot.l2: Yo Bot: upload complete. Please clap.

yooba.look: a green creature with eyes on stalks and a wide mouth taking up the torso
yooba.scene: in a swamp-bright studio laughing wide, eyes on stalks looking opposite ways, confetti in the open mouth, lily-pad stage
yooba.l2: Yooba yooba. The mouth has the last word.
